title: The spending is public. The source isn’t.
description: Section illustration of the dark-money trail: the two-line pull quote, then three boxes — two green-outlined with checkmarks (PAC spent $10.7M opposing a candidate — filed; nonprofit gave $3M to that PAC — filed) and a black void box with a large “?” and “no filing exists.”
alt_text: Dark graphic with the serif pull quote “The spending is public. The source isn’t.” Three boxes in a row: two outlined in green with checkmarks — PAC spent $10.7M opposing a candidate; nonprofit gave $3M to that PAC — and a third solid-black box with a large cream question mark and the words “no filing exists.”
creator: Daniel Ismael Aguilar
usage_note: Data visualization compiled from public FEC filings and cited press reporting. Figures: $11,077,173 spent opposing Graham Platner vs. $323,426 supporting (FEC Schedule E, deduplicated, Oct 2025 – Jul 8, 2026).
